Pixel Snake

A classic snake game with a pixel twist

How to Play

Use the arrow keys to move the snake. Eat the food to grow and increase your score. Avoid running into the walls or yourself!

Press any arrow key to start

How to Play

  • Arrow keys — Move the snake
  • Pause — Pause or resume the game
  • Restart — Start a new game

# Pixel Snake Game

A classic Snake game with a pixel aesthetic, built with plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. No dependencies, no network requests, fully offline.

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern browser. That's it!

## Controls

- **Arrow keys** — Move the snake
- **Pause / Resume button** — Pause or resume the game
- **Restart button** — Start a new game
- **Start Game / Play Again button** — Begin or restart from the overlay

## Features

- Start-paused with a "How to Play" overlay
- Score tracking
- Pause / resume
- Restart
- Game-over screen with final score
- Responsive layout down to 360px wide
- Keyboard-accessible, labeled controls with visible hover, focus, and pressed states

## Files

- `index.html` — Page structure
- `styles.css` — Theming and layout
- `game.js` — Game logic and rendering

## Notes

- No imports, packages, network requests, external assets, iframes, or server code.
- Arrow keys are prevented from scrolling the page.
- Canvas is scaled responsively while preserving the pixel look.
